build_qlearning: build a Q-learning loss op using qlearning with Q-values, actions, rewards, and pcontinue tensors
build_double_qlearning: build a double Q-learning loss op using double_qlearning with separate value and selector Q-tensors
build_sarsa: build a SARSA loss op using sarsa with current and next action Q-values
build_qlambda: build a Q(lambda) loss op using qlambda with multi-step forward view and lambda parameter
build_sarsa_lambda: build a SARSA(lambda) loss op using sarsa_lambda with multi-step expected returns
